title: Occasional
subtitle: Occasional = happening, appearing, or being done sometimes, but not regularly or frequentl
description: Occasional = happening, appearing, or being done sometimes, but not regularly or frequently。 替換時要分清 low frequency, on-and-off recurrence, scattered irregular events, lack of a fixed schedule, isolated cases, 以及需要把形容詞改寫成副詞片語的情況。

words.example: The system experiences only infrequent delays.
words.exampleZh: 這個系統只會偶爾出現延誤。

exercises.original: The service has occasional delays during busy periods.
exercises.zh: 繁忙時段服務偶爾會有延誤。
exercises.upgrade: The service has infrequent delays during busy periods.

options.explanation: Infrequent ✓ — not happening often; occurring only at relatively long intervals。本句關鍵是 low frequency is the main point；因此 Infrequent 最準確。
Sporadic — occurring at irregular, scattered intervals。sporadic 要有零星、無規律分布的感覺；若只是低頻、固定習慣或個別案例，未必最佳。
Rare — very uncommon or happening very seldom。rare 通常比 occasional 更強，表示非常少見；本句沒有那麼低頻。
Regular — occurring at fixed or expected intervals。regular 表示穩定、固定地出現，與 occasional 的低頻／不固定相反。
Periodic — recurring at intervals, often in a pattern。periodic 強調按間隔重複，常可帶規律性；不等於普通『偶爾』。
Random — without a predictable pattern or plan。random 強調不可預測，不直接表示低頻。

exercises.upgrade: Every so often, we get a power cut during storms.

options.explanation: From time to time — occasionally; on some occasions, but not regularly。from time to time 是副詞片語，需要重構句法；不能直接放在名詞前。
Infrequent — not happening often; occurring only at relatively long intervals。infrequent 只說低頻；若句子明確強調零星分布、個別案例或需要副詞式重構，另有更精準表達。
Every so often ✓ — occasionally, at irregular but noticeable intervals。本句關鍵是 informal recurring but irregular event；因此 Every so often 最準確。
Rare — very uncommon or happening very seldom。rare 通常比 occasional 更強，表示非常少見；本句沒有那麼低頻。
Regular — occurring at fixed or expected intervals。regular 表示穩定、固定地出現，與 occasional 的低頻／不固定相反。
Periodic — recurring at intervals, often in a pattern。periodic 強調按間隔重複，常可帶規律性；不等於普通『偶爾』。

falseSynonyms.zh: 罕見 ≠ occasional rare 通常表示非常少見，往往比 occasional 更低頻。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Rare is usually stronger.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定期的 ≠ occasional regular 表示按固定頻率／模式出現，與 occasional 不同。
週期性的 ≠ occasional periodic 可表示按規律間隔重複，不一定低頻。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Periodic implies recurrence at intervals.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隨機的 ≠ occasional random 描述不可預測性，不直接表示低頻。
只在斷斷續續 sense 接近 intermittent 要有 on-and-off pattern。
只在零星不規則 sense 接近 sporadic 比 occasional 更強調 scattered/irregular。
只在個別案例 sense 接近 isolated 指少數個別事件，不是一般『偶爾』。
詞性陷阱 occasional 是形容詞；occasionally 是副詞。
